description: We are a team of six students from TecNM Campus Saltillo, proudly representing the Burros Pardos in NASA Space Apps Challenge. For the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge, we aim to develop an immersive VR game or simulator that allows users to explore lunar missions, understand the challenges of landing on the Moon, and experience the future of space exploration.
summary: We develop a VR platform for astronauts to train before going to moon trips, for learning and explore the moon and different data about the moon, having the best angle for sending data to the earth, best light angle and more data to have in mind before ongoing trips
details: The differentiator that the project has is creating a VR experience even though the guidelines did not ask for it, talking about the software, we made the frontend in nextsjs and serve it through cloudflare workers, cloudflare cache and cloudflare proxies for security, in the backend we made lambdas written in rust programming language for less latency on the system, in hardware we used meta quest 3
